title: MAGNA-TILES Numbers (0-9) — Build, Trace & Write Activity

overview.description: 23-page printable number activity set (0-9). Each number gets a dedicated page with a large numeral outline designed for building with MAGNA-TILES or microMAGs directly on the page. Children build the number shape with tiles, then trace and write the numeral and number word. Combines manipulative play with handwriting practice. Multi-sensory approach: tactile (building), visual (seeing the shape), and motor (tracing/writing).

gaps.name: manipulative-building-mat
gaps.description: Large numeral/letter/shape outlines designed for children to build on top of with physical manipulatives (tiles, blocks, Legos). Needs enough scale for real objects. Different from tracing — this is 3D building.

multiSensory.description: Build (tactile) → Trace (visual-motor) → Write (fine motor). Three modalities for the same concept.
multiSensory.value: Multi-sensory number learning anchors recognition through multiple pathways.

notes: Interesting bridge between physical manipulatives and worksheets. Aless's interest suggests she values activities that connect hands-on play to academic skills.
